text: EverBank is owned by funds managed by Stone Point Capital, Warburg Pincus, Reverence Capital Partners, Sixth Street and Bayview Asset Management, each of which holds a non-controlling interest, alongside TIAA, which retains a non-controlling stake.
short: EverBank is owned by funds managed by Stone Point Capital, Warburg Pincus, Reverence Capital Partners, Sixth Street and Bayview Asset Management, each….

source.name: TIAA press release: TIAA Completes Sale of TIAA Bank to Private Investors (via Stone Point Capital news)
source.quote: The new investors that now each own non-controlling interests in EverBank are funds managed by Stone Point Capital, Warburg Pincus, Reverence Capital Partners, Sixth Street and Bayview Asset Management.
